core_problem_solved: To provide a complete and compliant YAML 1.1 processor for Java, enabling applications to parse YAML documents into Java objects and serialize Java objects into YAML strings.
key_features: Parsing YAML into standard Java objects (`Map`, `List`, etc.)
Serializing Java objects into YAML documents
Support for data binding to custom Plain Old Java Objects (POJOs)
A comprehensive API for fine-grained control over parsing and emission
era_and_niche: The de facto industry standard for all YAML processing in the Java ecosystem. It is a core, foundational dependency for many popular frameworks, most notably the Spring Boot framework, which uses it for parsing `application.yml` configuration files.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete**. It is the actively maintained, leading library in its category. There are no major competitors with the same level of adoption or feature completeness in the Java world.
